name: Xojo
description_en:
Xojo combines a visual IDE, its object-oriented programming language, framework, debugger and compiler for desktop, web and mobile applications. Drag-and-drop controls define a user interface; event handlers and application code provide behavior. Cross-platform targeting does not mean every target uses the same UI classes or can be shipped without target-specific work.

The official desktop quickstart builds a small browser window, while database and deployment guides explain transaction handling and standalone web hosting. This profile uses those concrete paths to evaluate development and operations; current AI-agent features are not treated as a tested substitute for programming.
description_zh:
Xojo 结合可视 IDE、面向对象语言、框架、调试器及编译器，用于桌面、网页及移动应用。拖放控件定义界面，事件处理器与应用代码实现行为。支持跨平台不代表所有目标使用相同界面类，或无需各平台工作即可分发。

官方桌面入门构建小型浏览器窗口，数据库及部署指南解释事务处理与独立网页应用托管。本文通过这些具体流程评估开发及运维，不将当前 AI Agent 功能视为已实测的编程替代品。

sections.title_en: Trace an event from a visual control to code
sections.title_zh: 从可视控件追踪事件到代码
sections.en: The Desktop QuickStart creates SimpleBrowser with a text field, button and HTML viewer. It names the controls, configures edge locking for resizing and places a LoadURL call in the button’s Pressed handler, reading the address field’s Text property. Run launches a debug application for evaluation. Follow that chain in a disposable project, then try a malformed/unreachable URL and a resized window. A working tutorial is not evidence that a complete app has input validation, navigation policy or portable layouts. No IDE was installed here.
sections.zh: 桌面快速入门建立含文本框、按钮及 HTML 查看器的 SimpleBrowser，为控件命名、设置边缘锁定以适应缩放，并在按钮 Pressed 事件中读取地址框 Text 调用 LoadURL。Run 启动调试应用供评估。建议在可丢弃项目追踪此链路，再试错误／不可达 URL 及缩放窗口。教程可运行不能证明完整应用已有输入校验、导航策略或可移植布局。本次未安装 IDE。

sections.title_en: Multiple related writes need an explicit transaction
sections.title_zh: 相关多次写入需要明确事务
sections.en: The transaction guide explains why committing each half of a related update can leave partial state. SQLite implicitly commits each command unless an explicit transaction is started; documented code catches DatabaseException, rolls back and stops after a failed write. Other engines differ, so inspect the engine’s transaction and isolation behavior. A proposed inventory transfer should test failure between decrement and increment, then verify both rows. A successful UI event or external request does not prove the database changes were committed atomically.
sections.zh: 事务指南解释分开提交相关更新两部分会留下部分状态。SQLite 未明确开启事务时各命令隐式提交；文档代码捕获 DatabaseException，回滚并在失败写后停止。其他引擎有所不同，需检查其事务与隔离行为。建议库存调拨测试扣减与增加之间失败，再核对两行。界面事件或外部请求成功不能证明数据库改动原子提交。

sections.title_en: Database access still needs bound input and application rules
sections.title_zh: 数据库访问仍需绑定输入与应用规则
sections.en: The database guide recommends prepared SQL: define placeholders and pass values to SelectSQL rather than inserting user input into a SQL string. It also identifies DatabaseRow and RowSet editing APIs as safer paths for this input-handling problem. That addresses the documented SQL injection mechanism, not every application authorization requirement. For a search/update screen, use parameter binding, enforce the intended user/record scope and test a rejected operation. No database or security test was performed in this research.
sections.zh: 数据库指南建议预备 SQL：定义占位符，将值传给 SelectSQL，而非把用户输入拼进 SQL 字符串；也介绍 DatabaseRow 及 RowSet 编辑 API 对该输入问题的保护。它针对文档中的 SQL 注入机制，不涵盖全部应用授权。建议搜索／更新页绑定参数、落实用户／记录范围并测试拒绝操作。本次未运行数据库或安全测试。

sections.title_en: A standalone web build needs an operating server process
sections.title_zh: 独立网页构建需要持续运行的服务进程
sections.en: Web deployment can use Xojo Cloud or a standalone compiled app. Standalone includes the web server and application, must remain running on the chosen port and needs an OS-compatible build plus executable libraries. The guide discourages typical shared hosting, says CGI deployment ended in 2020r1, and excludes custom server configuration from support. Check server logs and permissions when launch fails. Managed Cloud is a separate hosting service, constrained by resources; neither route proves production recovery, unlimited capacity or an included hosting price.
sections.zh: 网页部署可用 Xojo Cloud 或独立编译应用。独立应用包含网页服务器与业务程序，必须在指定端口持续运行，需匹配服务器 OS 并使库可执行。指南不推荐一般共享主机，说明 2020r1 起不再支持 CGI，且不支持代配自有服务器。启动失败需查服务器日志与权限。Cloud 是单独托管服务，受资源限制；两条路径均不能证明生产恢复、不限容量或已包含托管费。

sections.title_en: Match a build license to the platform and feature set
sections.title_zh: 按目标平台及功能选择构建许可
sections.en: The current store lists Desktop, Mobile and Web at $499 USD each, Pro at $999 and Pro Plus at $1,999. The first three allow two activations, Pro three and Pro Plus six. Pro covers all platform groups and console apps; the Web tier excludes multicore support in the displayed table. The store separately offers free Linux desktop/console builds. It does not establish a monthly subscription conversion here. Confirm renewal/update entitlement, taxes, add-ons, target requirements and any Cloud hosting fee before budgeting.
sections.zh: 当前商店列 Desktop、Mobile 与 Web 各 $499 美元，Pro $999，Pro Plus $1,999；前三项允许两次激活，Pro 三次，Pro Plus 六次。Pro 覆盖全部平台组及控制台应用，表中 Web 不含多核支持。商店另列 Linux 桌面／控制台免费构建。本次不将这些价格转成月订阅；预算前需确认续期／更新权、税、附加项、目标要求及 Cloud 托管费用。

sections.title_en: Free IDE execution and distribution rights differ
sections.title_zh: 免费 IDE 执行与分发权不同
sections.en: The full EULA permits creating projects and running from the IDE without charge, then generally requires a matching build key for standalone distribution/deployment and a key for text/XML project saving. It prohibits modifying or reverse engineering the IDE/framework and treats keys as personal to the licensed user. Its blanket build-key wording is broader than the current free Linux offer, and its activation text does not describe the Pro Plus store tier. Keep those scope differences explicit and confirm current applicable terms rather than declaring the IDE open source or assuming all compiled targets are free.
sections.zh: 完整 EULA 允许免费创建项目并从 IDE 运行，通常要求独立分发／部署购买对应构建 key，文本／XML 项目保存也需 key；禁止修改或逆向 IDE／框架，并要求 key 由获许可本人使用。一般构建 key 表述宽于当前 Linux 免费方案，激活文字也未说明商店 Pro Plus 层级。应保留范围差异、确认适用当前条款，不能称 IDE 开源或假设全部编译目标免费。
